items.name: notchset-skill
items.title: Notchset agent skill
items.description: Teaches Claude Code and other agents to find, install and compose Notchset items with the library's design, motion and copy rules.

items.name: notchset-ai
items.title: Notchset AI rules
items.description: Rules and a routing table that tell Claude Code, Cursor and other agents how to use Notchset components in this project.
items.docs: Notchset AI rules installed in .notchset/AGENTS.md. Using Claude Code? Add the line @.notchset/AGENTS.md to your CLAUDE.md so it reads them.

items.name: notchset-font-sans
items.title: Notchset sans font (Geist)
items.description: Geist from Google Fonts as --font-sans.

items.name: notchset-font-mono
items.title: Notchset mono font (Geist Mono)
items.description: Geist Mono from Google Fonts as --font-mono.

items.name: base
items.title: Notchset base
items.description: A new project set up for Notchset: the theme and its fonts, the foundation every item needs, and the @notchset and @notchset-pro registries in components.json.
items.docs: Notchset is set up. Add any free item with @notchset/<id>; Pro items install with @notchset-pro/<id> once NOTCHSET_TOKEN is in .env.local (https://notchset.dev/docs/pro).

items.name: notchset-theme
items.title: Notchset theme
items.description: The shadcn tokens in light and dark, in the Amethyst and Graphite Signatures. Optional: the components follow any shadcn theme.

items.description: The roles every component is built from (surfaces, ink, signal, type, space, sizes, radii, motion), read from the shadcn tokens. Installed once, by any component.

items.name: activity-feed
items.title: Activity feed
items.description: What happened on a record, newest first and grouped by day: who did it, what, and the time, with emails and notes carrying their words. Tabs filter by kind with counts; older entries wait behind one honest line.

items.name: check-list
items.title: Check list and ask tags
items.description: A thing measured against rules (a quote against the approval policy), one line per rule: the rule, its value and what it means. The icon and the words carry the state. Ask tags list only what needs someone.

items.name: command-bar
items.title: Command bar
items.description: Say what you want in plain words and see what it will do first: the words turn into chips and one line says the consequence. Enter runs it, Tab completes, Esc clears. The host writes the verbs, so nothing is guessed.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data table
items.description: A list of records with a sticky header, column headers that sort their natural way first, rows that open on press and a selection column. The host owns the sort order, the selection and the row keys, so Shift-click runs or J, K, Enter and X match the rest of its app. On a phone it becomes a calm list.

items.name: hero-orb
items.title: Hero orb
items.description: The Orb at hero size for a landing page: it plays a conversation as soon as it is seen, its light following a voice through a spring, then hands over at the first touch. Four knobs tune glow, grain, warmth and response. No sound; still with less motion.

items.name: live-activity-bar
items.title: Live activity bar
items.description: The next thing on your day, held above a phone's tab bar: it counts down live, turns into Now with one calm pulse, opens into a small card when pressed and folds away when dismissed. Nothing moves at rest.

items.name: notch-island
items.title: Notch island
items.description: A small dark island at the top of a screen that reshapes to hold what just happened: a call coming in, a file going up, a thing done. The shape changes first and the words arrive a beat after.

items.name: pipeline-shapes
items.title: One pipeline, five shapes
items.description: The same deals as a board, a list, the forecast's stacks, a month of close dates and the people who own them. Each deal travels to its place in the next shape and the total never changes, because the facts don't.

items.name: quarter-drop
items.title: Drop a deal, the quarter answers
items.description: A few deals in their stages over the quarter's progress toward quota. Move a card and everything that depends on it answers: the totals roll, the bar moves, and crossing quota sweeps the ring once. A refused save goes home with Retry.

items.name: scrub-chart
items.title: Scrub chart
items.description: One figure over time against a target, in the chart family's ink style. Drag across it or use the arrow keys and the headline rolls to that point, with how far it sits from the target in words, while a halo and a dark pill follow you. The last point is where it rests.

items.name: settings-layout
items.title: Settings layout
items.description: A list of sections beside the open one, each made of groups of rows: what the setting does on the left, its control on the right, taking effect as it changes. On a phone the list comes first.

items.name: share-view
items.title: Share this view
items.description: The Share pill opens into the panel it was hiding, in place: copy the link, pick who can open it, add people and Send. A sent share folds back into a pill that says who has it; a failed one keeps everything and offers Retry.

items.name: showcase-wall
items.title: Showcase wall
items.description: The live pieces a homepage leads with, each big and touchable on a soft wash, with its name and what happens when you touch it underneath. Tiles mount as they come near the screen and hold their place.

items.name: sign-in
items.title: Sign in and onboarding step
items.description: Two ways in: a link proves the inbox and sets up a workspace; a passkey goes straight into an account you already have. Then check your email, or confirm it's you. The onboarding step asks one question per screen. `personal` drops the work wording and single sign-on for a consumer app (Health).

items.name: sign-to-close
items.title: Sign to close
items.description: A small order form that ends in a signature: draw it, with Undo and Clear, or type your name. Signing flips the deal to Won and the Signature traces the card once; a refused signature keeps the ink and offers Retry. A line marked one-time is totalled apart: recurring per year, one-time and the first year.

items.name: stage-checklist
items.title: Stage checklist
items.description: What a step usually needs before it moves on, ticking itself as each thing comes true, and saying "Ready to move on" at the end. A soft gate: it informs and never blocks.

items.name: activity-heatmap
items.title: Activity heatmap
items.description: When work happens: each working day a cell in a step of a validated green ramp, by week. Focus it and the arrows walk the days with a dark pill naming the day and its count; a key reads less to more, a chip says the longest streak, and a table carries every day for a screen reader.

items.name: adherence-dots
items.title: Adherence dots
items.description: One row of seven dots per routine item: filled when it happened, outlined when it didn't, today dashed until it happens, and the count closing the row. A table carries every day in words for a screen reader.

items.name: avatar-stack
items.title: Avatar stack
items.description: Who is on something: avatars overlapping, each cut out of the surface by a ring of it, then "+N". It reads out as one phrase: "Ana Ruiz, Kevin Ito and 3 more".

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: A person's photo, or their initials on a soft wash of their own hue when there is no photo. It sits beside the name, so it is decoration by default; announce it when it stands alone.

items.name: banner
items.title: Banner
items.description: Something about this page to know before acting ("Close date passed 3 days ago"): the fact in bold, the detail, then at most one action that fixes it. The tone tints; the words carry the meaning. A card layout holds a record's own status.

items.name: baseline-meter
items.title: Baseline meter
items.description: Nights in ink fill with the series as each one is measured, the count written (9 of 14 nights) and what's left, so nothing is read against a usual that doesn't exist yet. Full, it becomes the range bar of your usual with today on it. A night added while it's on screen pops in once.

items.name: bottom-sheet
items.title: Bottom sheet
items.description: A phone's place for a short set of choices or a small form. It rises from the bottom with a grab handle and closes by swiping down, tapping outside or Esc. On a desktop, use a Menu or a Dialog.

items.name: brand-lockup
items.title: Brand lockup
items.description: The product's own brand, drawn one way in every template: the plus in the Signature, then the lowercase wordmark in ink, in three sizes. A buyer swaps their name and mark in one place. Customer companies are a different thing (company mark).

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb and back
items.description: Where this page sits, said once in the top bar: quiet parent links, then the page's title. On a phone the parents give way to one Back to the nearest parent, so the bar never wraps.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: The one action shape: secondary by default, one primary per region, ghost for quiet row actions and danger for a confirmed destructive step. Busy shows a spinner beside its words and ignores presses until it's done.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: The grid every date picker shares. Press the title for the months and again for the years, so a far date needs no paging. Range mode washes the days between as you hover; arrows, Page Up and Page Down move by day, week, month and year.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: A section of a page on the panel surface, with 12px corners and a hairline. Its header says what it holds, a quiet count and at most one link to the page it summarises; a footer sits at the bottom edge.

items.name: chart
items.title: Chart
items.description: The parts every chart is drawn with, so all read as one family: a smooth line in the series hue over a fading area, a halo and a dark pill that follow the pointer or arrow keys, the period raised on the axis, a faint mono grid, one hero figure, and a table for screen readers.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: A 16px rounded square that fills with ink when checked, or with the ok colour for finishing a task (it pops once). Mixed shows a dash. Its children are its label, and on touch screens the hit area grows to 40px.

items.name: chip
items.title: Chip
items.description: One applied filter or picked value, raised like a button, with its own remove. The remove button says what it removes ("Remove Owner: Ana"), so a row of chips reads clearly to a screen reader.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: Pick one of a long list by typing: the first match is highlighted, so type then Enter picks it. It shows what is chosen when closed and says "No matches" rather than an empty box.

items.name: command-menu
items.title: Command menu
items.description: Go anywhere or do anything by typing. Results are grouped, the first match is chosen, arrows move and Enter runs it. Each word you type matches the start of a word in a label or its keywords; nothing found says so.

items.name: company-mark
items.title: Company mark
items.description: A company's colour as a rounded square with its initial or its glyph. The colour is the company's own data, the one place a component takes a raw colour; the name sits beside it, so the mark is decoration.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: Date picker
items.description: A due date or a close date: the shortcuts people mostly want beside a calendar, so it fits the window. Or type it ("nov 3", "next fri", "in 2 weeks") and read it back as a date before Enter takes it. A bottom sheet on a phone.

items.name: date-range-picker
items.title: Date range picker
items.description: A report's period. Presets first, each with its dates written out, or press a start and an end on the calendar. The trigger says the range in words; Esc mid-pick keeps the old range.

items.name: day-timeline
items.title: Day timeline
items.description: Wearable events, logs and routine ticks on one day axis, solid up to now and dotted after, with Now as the one lit mark and the coach's pick glowing. At most six entries (the pick and those nearest now) with View the day for the rest; upright as a list on a phone, and an ordered list for a screen reader either way.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: One focused step: a title that says it, a line that says what happens, the form, then Cancel and the one verb, rightmost. A dangerous verb says what it destroys and is red. Enter runs it from a field; a sheet on a phone.

items.name: draw-history
items.title: Draw history
items.description: A segmented standing bar (low, in range, optimal, in range, high) with the latest value haloed on it and the draw before as a hollow ring; under it every draw as a large dated dot with its value on a calm line, over the optimal band and the lab's lower limit, and the planned retest as a dotted ring at its date.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: Empty state
items.description: What goes here and the one way to fill it. A page-sized one centres a title, a line and an action; inline, it is the quiet line inside a section ("No notes yet").

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: A label above a control, then a hint or the error, read together. An error marks the control invalid. It also gives every text control the same recessed well and the ink hairline on focus.

items.name: filter-button
items.title: Filter button
items.description: One facet of a list (Stage, Owner). Unused it is a dashed outline; once something is picked it turns solid and counts the picks. Its menu stays open while you tick several, with Clear at the bottom.

items.name: flood-tile
items.title: Flood tile
items.description: A page's key figure on the Signature's gradient, grain on top, white type that passes AA, a fine arc or ruler drawn large; the standing rides on it as a white pill. One per page. With drift its light moves over about 52 s, paused when hidden or off screen and still under reduced motion.

items.name: ghost-trend
items.title: Ghost trend
items.description: A metric over a period: the luminous line, last period's as a dashed ghost, your usual as a soft band, the dashed average and the latest point haloed. A second signal shares the axis as % from your usual. Gaps stay gaps or are bridged dotted, the lowest and highest pinned; a logged dose is a grey diamond along the top.

items.name: glance-tile
items.title: Glance tile
items.description: A label, a status line, one small visual that means something (a reason glyph: an arc with the usual band, a span against a window, readings in or out of their bands, two dots that align, or a run of days) and a value in light type, on one grid. Tonal, no glow; each opens its page.

items.name: glucose-day
items.title: Glucose day
items.description: Every 5 minutes as one luminous line over the target band, a quiet wash with its edges written at the left. Each meal is a grey dot where it was eaten, its peak a series dot with the rise above; a dose is a grey diamond along the top. Gaps stay open; a running day stops at now. The table carries every hour.

items.name: goal-cumulative
items.title: Goal cumulative
items.description: The period's running total climbs as the luminous line with a soft fill and a dot per step, the period before as a dashed ghost and the goal as one dashed ink line named at its end. The latest point is haloed with its total, and says goal met once it is. The table carries every step.

items.name: hover-momentum
items.title: Hover momentum
items.description: A card that shows its recent activity only when you ask: hover or focus grows a small bar chart of the last days with its one line of meaning, and it folds away when you leave. Nothing new at rest.

items.name: hue-mesh
items.title: Hue mesh
items.description: A soft pastel mesh of one of the family's category hues over frosted white (deep and glowing in dark), entering from the same top-left corner on every tile. Identity, never standing.

items.name: icon-button
items.title: Icon button
items.description: A square button holding one icon. Its label is required: it is the accessible name and the tooltip a pointer user sees, so the two can never disagree.

items.name: inline-bar
items.title: Inline bar
items.description: A thin bar inside a table cell with its number beside it, so rows compare at a glance and the number still answers. The figures keep one column edge; in a cell too narrow for both, only the number shows.

items.name: inline-edit
items.title: Inline edit
items.description: A value you change where you read it. It reads as text; a click or Enter makes it a field, Enter or leaving saves and Esc puts it back. A refused value keeps the field open and says why; a failed save offers Retry.

items.name: keyboard-hint
items.title: Keyboard hint
items.description: Keycaps for a shortcut ("⌘K", or G then S). Hidden on touch screens, where there is no keyboard. The shortcut must work: a printed key nobody bound is a bug.

items.name: knobs
items.title: Knobs
items.description: One Tune control, closed by default, that opens labelled sliders (each with its value written) or a choice of a few words for a showcase piece's physics (Tension, Damping), and the ghost cursor that acts a moment out while the piece plays. Keys move every knob.

items.name: light-field
items.title: Light field
items.description: A wide soft wash of the Signature's light entering from the top right and fading before the page's lower half; in dark it becomes an edge light from the right. Never an orb shape, grain on top, one per page, decoration only.

items.name: line-figure
items.title: Line figure
items.description: A hairline figure in ink at 70%, its construction lines dotted: nested circles converging (a receipt), two cones meeting (an approval), a wireframe cube (contained), or your own shapes. It draws in once on entering view, then holds still; with less motion, or `still` (a small figure), it is simply there.

items.name: load-range
items.title: Load range
items.description: The figure and its standing in words, one track from light to heavy with your usual as a soft band and the load as a glowing dot, and the figures it comes from (acute, chronic, ratio) as quiet rows.

items.name: menu
items.title: Menu
items.description: The actions for a thing, opened from a button. Items carry an icon and the shortcut the app binds; group labels name a set, and the one destructive step is said in words and red. A bottom sheet on a phone.

items.name: message
items.title: Message
items.description: A reply that streams with Stop at any length, keeps what it wrote when stopped (Continue, Try again), says Still working after 8 s and names what answered under it. Edits and retries are versions in place, none deleted. Screen readers hear start, working, done, stopped and failed.

items.name: meter
items.title: Meter
items.description: How much of something is used or done, as a thin bar beside the number that says it. Progress fills in ink, or the ok colour for an achievement; usage warns from 75% and turns bad when full.

items.name: model-selector
items.title: Model selector
items.description: Up to four choices named by purpose, each with a line on when to pick it and the model's name; no hidden Auto. One that can't answer now stays listed with why. An assistant that fixes its model shows it as set, by whom. The host binds the shortcut that opens it.

items.name: night-dot-row
items.title: Night dot row
items.description: Seven nights as dots with each day and figure: hollow when below your usual, the chosen night ringed and lit. A radio group: arrow keys, Home and End move and choose, and each dot says its night in words.

items.name: night-ribbon
items.title: Night ribbon
items.description: Awake, REM, Light and Deep as lanes, each stretch a rounded capsule in the stage's tint joined to the next by a soft riser, so the night reads as one ribbon. The longest deep stretch glows with its pill; the axis says bedtime, a few hours and wake, and the table carries every stretch.

items.name: night-tags
items.title: Night tags
items.description: Tags on a night from the Log and the routine, each with its time, with Add a tag and, when the coach has one, a single cited correlation about your own nights with its source in mono. A fact, never advice.

items.name: orb
items.title: Orb
items.description: A frosted-glass lamp lit from inside that says what the assistant is doing: Ready drifts, Listening lights the edge facing your voice, Thinking moves in the notch rhythm, Speaking swells, Done pulses once. A word under every state; one moving orb per viewport; a still per state with less motion.

items.name: overlay-chips
items.title: Overlay chips
items.description: Toggle chips under a trend: the one on shows its swatch, name and latest reading and takes it off again; the rest wait as quiet + chips. One overlay at a time, so the chart keeps one honest axis.

items.name: person-card
items.title: Person card
items.description: A person's role, team, local time and open work in a small card that opens on hover or focus of their face or name, without leaving the page. The trigger is a link to their page, so a touch goes straight there; the card holds no action the page doesn't.

items.name: personal-bests
items.title: Personal bests
items.description: Quiet fact rows for a metric (highest night, best month, longest run over your usual), each with its value and date. No badges and no colour: a best is a fact, not a prize. A month without readings says when bests arrive.

items.name: priority-mark
items.title: Priority mark
items.description: A task's priority at 14px without colour: three ink bars climbing from low to high, a filled ink square for urgent, three faint bars for none. It says its level to a screen reader.

items.name: prism-edge
items.title: Prism edge
items.description: A hairline of the Signature turning through its light round a glass card, with a whisper of spectral tint at one corner, all code. When something new arrives it sweeps once in about 1.2 s and rests; never on a mount, and under reduced motion the edge simply shows. Used once per app.

items.name: prompt-input
items.title: Prompt input
items.description: Enter sends, Shift+Enter makes a new line, an input method's keys stay its own. While a reply runs it is Stop and a new message waits with Send now. Dictation shows your words live. Microphone refused, offline or at the plan's limit, the draft is kept and the line says why.

items.name: property-pill
items.title: Property pill
items.description: One property of a record (a status, an assignee, a due date, a priority, labels) as a small raised control showing its value and mark, or what it would hold in a quieter tone. It takes a ref and passes its props through, so it can be a menu's or a popover's trigger; tone bad says the value is a problem.

items.name: radio-cards
items.title: Radio cards
items.description: One choice from a few where each option needs a line to explain it: an icon, the option, its line and the radio dot. The chosen card gets an ink edge; arrow keys move the choice. One or two columns.

items.name: range-bar
items.title: Range bar
items.description: A value against a named range, never bare: the lab's band with its limits written, an optimal band named by its source, the value with its halo, the previous value as a tick and the word (Low, In range, High). Out of range is warn; a lab flag or a value that may be wrong is bad. Three sizes.

items.name: range-control
items.title: Range control
items.description: Day, Week, Month, 6M, Year and YTD as one switch with the period's headline above it: "Avg 6 h 51 · this week, +9 min against last week". The figure rolls only when the period changes, still with less motion; a period the data can't reach is left out.

items.name: reason-glyph
items.title: Reason glyph
items.description: Five small data glyphs, each drawing the reason for a judging word: a value against its usual band (arc), a span against a window, readings in or out of their bands (marks), two-point alignment and a run of days. Fills a tile's band, or sits inline before its word in a list row; never without its word.

items.name: reason-popover
items.title: Reason popover
items.description: A step that needs one line of why before it runs (deny, decline, pause), asked right where it was pressed. Enter runs it; an empty reason says what to write. For steps Undo can take back; an irreversible one is a Dialog.

items.name: recipient-field
items.title: Recipient field
items.description: Who an email goes to: a chip per person with their avatar. Type a name or address and Enter adds the first match; Backspace takes off the last chip. A full new address can be added as itself.

items.name: results-strip
items.title: Results strip
items.description: A whole panel at a glance: one tick per result, grouped by system, in range quiet ink, out of range warn, a value to check outlined bad, with the counts written. Point or use the arrow keys to read a tick (one tab stop); press, Enter or Space opens it. The host orders the items.

items.name: reveal
items.title: Reveal
items.description: A row your action adds or removes grows into place and folds away instead of popping, so what's below moves smoothly. It animates only on your change; closed content is inert, and reduced motion swaps at once.

items.name: rolling-number
items.title: Rolling number
items.description: A figure that changes because of what you did rolls only the digits that changed, right to left, so you see where the change landed. It never counts up on arrival; screen readers hear the final value once.

items.name: route-map
items.title: Route map
items.description: GPS points in Web Mercator at the zoom that fits them, over XYZ tiles, a vector street map in the page's roles (roads by class, buildings, parks, water, names along roads), or paper. The line is the signal: start, finish flag, chevrons, km marks, records and a live heading dot whose halo beats at the heart rate.

items.name: route-trace
items.title: Route trace
items.description: GPS points projected flat and fitted to the box, drawn in the series hue over a soft halo with a hollow start, a filled finish and a small mark at each whole kilometre. No tiles and no provider key; a buyer adds streets behind the same drawing.

items.name: routine-checklist
items.title: Routine checklist
items.description: Each item is a tick, its planned time in mono, the item and one quiet line: your note, who ticked it ("ticked 07:10", "from the ring") or the coach's pick. A note is added in place, saved with Enter and dropped with Escape. The count sits in the head; no streaks or badges.

items.name: ruler
items.title: Ruler
items.description: Hairline ticks at an even step, your usual band as the solid stretch at its foot and the value as one taller mark, with the band's limits in mono. Sits under a hero number so it reads as a measurement.

items.name: search-field
items.title: Search field
items.description: Filters what is on the page as you type. Esc clears it, a clear button appears once there is text, and a printed shortcut key focuses it. Dense beside a table's tabs or wide at the top of a list.

items.name: secret-reveal
items.title: Secret reveal
items.description: A secret shown the one time it exists outside the server (a new API key): the whole value in mono, selectable, one Copy that says Copied, and a plain line saying it won't be shown again.

items.name: segmented-control
items.title: Segmented control
items.description: Two to five views or modes of the same thing (List | Board). The chosen one is raised on a recessed well and one is always chosen. Arrow keys move between options; a count can sit beside a label.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Pick one of a short, known list. The list drops below the control and is a sheet on a phone. A field select sits in a form; a property select is the compact chip a side panel uses for a value changed in place.

items.name: side-panel
items.title: Side panel
items.description: A record opened beside the list it came from. It isn't modal: the list stays usable and another row swaps the record. J and K step through the list; Esc closes. On a phone it takes the screen above the tab bar.

items.name: skeleton-reveal
items.title: Skeleton reveal
items.description: The shape of what's coming while it loads, then the real rows in its place with no jump: placeholder and content share one box, and the rows rise in with a short stagger. Never a spinner in content.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: The shape of text that is still loading, with a slow shimmer. Hidden from screen readers (the loading region says aria-busy); under reduced motion the shimmer stops and the shape stays.

items.name: sortable-header
items.title: Sortable header
items.description: A table column you can sort by: press to sort, again to flip. Each column has a natural first direction (names A to Z, money high to low), so the first press gives the useful order. The th carries aria-sort.

items.name: sparkline
items.title: Sparkline
items.description: A trend at a glance, with no axes: the chart family's line in small (a smooth line in the series hue over a wash that fades, ending in a dot), or one bar per period where the recent bars are stronger and a silent run turns to the warning colour. The words beside it carry the number.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: Inline "working", the size of the text it sits in: four ink dots that turn a quarter as the square breathes, then rest a beat. It never takes a colour and always sits beside words that say what is happening.

items.name: stage-chips
items.title: Stage chips
items.description: Each stage's total as a chip with its swatch; the stage that stands out is raised and carries its usual in mono. A plain list, read the same by a screen reader.

items.name: stage-path
items.title: Stage path
items.description: Where a record is in its process: passed stages with their days, the current one solid, later ones grey. Press a stage to move the record there. A closed record ends in its outcome, Won or Lost, and how long it took.

items.name: standing-arc
items.title: Standing arc
items.description: A hairline arc with fine ticks from Lower to Higher, your usual as the solid segment and the value as a glass bead on the arc carrying the number; the distance from your usual said under it.

items.name: state-bar
items.title: State bar
items.description: Where things sit right now, as one stacked bar: each state of work in its own colour, at the same strengths a cumulative flow's bands use, and a key under it that writes every state's count, a zero included. With onSelect, each key opens the records it counts.

items.name: status-glyph
items.title: Status glyph
items.description: Where a task is, by shape, so colour stays free for exceptions: a dashed ring for backlog, a ring for to do, half for in progress, three quarters for review, a slash for cancelled, all ink; done fills green with a tick. Given onComplete it is the button that finishes the task; the fill pops once.

items.name: status-pill
items.title: Status pill
items.description: A record's state in its own colour, as a word: a dot and the state. Only warn and bad are tinted, so a column of pills reads calm and the exception stands out; ended states recede to an outline.

items.name: stress-strip
items.title: Stress strip
items.description: Load rises above a hairline (stressed tall in the series hue, engaged short and lighter), restoring dips below it in grey and calm is the hairline, so the day reads in two seconds. Gaps stay empty; the minutes in each state sit under it. It draws states the caller supplies.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: A setting that takes effect the moment it flips, with no Save. Off is a quiet track, on is ink. Its children are its label, and on touch screens the hit area grows to 40px.

items.name: system-glyph
items.title: System glyph
items.description: An empty ring is none, a half moon is half, a full disc is all: a shape, not a colour, always beside its count in words.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: The saved slices of one list (All 17 · Mine 3). The chosen tab is raised with a count beside each label; arrow keys move between them, and more tabs than room scroll sideways and fade at the edge.

items.name: text-field
items.title: Text field and text area
items.description: A Field with a native input or textarea in the system's well. Everything a native input takes passes through, so browsers and password managers keep working. Give it a label, or an aria-label.

items.name: tick-bar
items.title: Tick bar
items.description: How far toward a target, as a row of thin ticks filled up to the value, with the number written beside it. Done draws its share in the ok colour, and a raised tick marks the target once the scale runs past it.

items.name: time-picker
items.title: Time picker
items.description: A meeting's start: type it any way ("2:30pm", "1430", "noon") and the list jumps to that time, or pick from it. Common slots sit beside it as chips; 12 or 24 hours follows the reader's locale unless set.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Says what just happened in two lines, the outcome then the detail, with the one way back (Undo) or Retry on a failure. One at a time; read out politely, paused while hovered, and swipeable. Mount the Toaster once.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A visual label for something that has no words of its own: an icon button, a collapsed sidebar, cut-off text. 350ms the first time, then instant while you scan; keyboard focus shows it too.

items.name: trace
items.title: Trace
items.description: The provenance line under a reading (Ring / 07:02, Northside Lab · 16 Oct); pressed, it opens the slip: the source, when it was measured, the range it was read against and who set that range. The receipt's face, for a value.

items.name: week-bars
items.title: Week bars
items.description: Bars by day in the series' soft tint with each value written inside its top, today lit in the lilac focus and the period's average as a dashed line. Scrub or use the arrow keys to read a day; a day with nothing recorded is a dashed stub, never a zero; the table carries every day.

items.name: zone-stack
items.title: Zone stack
items.description: Zones 1 to 5 stacked per day in one ramp of the series hue, lightest to full, so it reads as effort and never as five categories (grey in Graphite). Each day's total sits over its bar; days still to come stay empty. The table carries every zone.
